reviews.heading: Let our customers do the talking...

1.review: Since I started sending all my estimates using Contractor+, I have stopped losing bids. The professional image I gain by using this app is helping me win more business. Contractor+ is a game changer!

2.review: I love being able to keep track of my entire business in one app. And the leads we've been getting from Contractor+ are so much better than the leads we've got from other places. The app is easy to use and is making my life a lot easier.

3.review: We've got two crews working 5 to 6 days a week now. A year ago, it was just me. We would have never been able to grow like we have if it wasn't for Contractor+. The scheduling and client agreements makes my life a lot easier. Contractor+ ROCKS!

4.review: I switched from Jobber to Contractor+ because it fits the way I run my business. Clear communication, easy estimates, and job scheduling help me stay on top of everything. Contractor+ made my business more profitable and easier to manage.

5.review: I started with Contractor+ about 6 months ago and it's completely transformed how I manage my jobs and communicate with clients. Everything is streamlined now. It's the best investment I've made for my business.

6.review: Contractor+ gave me the structure I needed. From estimates to invoices, everything feels professional and clients love the clarity. It's the backbone of my business now.

7.review: I never realized how much time I was wasting until I started using Contractor+. It's simplified our operations and made client communication seamless.

8.review: Managing multiple job sites used to be chaos. Now I stay organized with schedules, client notes, and tasks all in one place. Contractor+ is a lifesaver!

9.review: I’m finally running my business instead of it running me. Contractor+ helps me stay on top of projects, and my clients appreciate the detailed estimates and updates.

10.review: Before Contractor+, everything was on paper. Now, everything's on my phone or tablet. I save hours each week just by having everything organized digitally.

11.review: From onboarding clients to sending final invoices, Contractor+ covers it all. It’s user-friendly, powerful, and has boosted our team's productivity big time.

12.review: We’ve doubled our client base in less than a year with Contractor+. Estimates are faster, scheduling is easier, and we’re getting more 5-star reviews than ever.

13.review: The app’s communication features and document templates are incredible. Our team runs more efficiently and clients stay updated throughout every phase.

14.review: I've tried other apps, but nothing compares to Contractor+. It's intuitive, affordable, and actually made for contractors. Highly recommend it.

15.review: Contractor+ eliminated double entry and reduced admin time by half. It integrates everything we need into one reliable system.

16.review: Job scheduling, reminders, and payments are now smooth and on time. I can finally focus on service quality instead of juggling spreadsheets and missed calls.
